statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); effort=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // empty'); session=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_name // empty'); dir=$(basename "$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir' | sed "s|^$HOME|~|")"); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); rl5h=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); rl7d=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty'); if [ -n "$effort" ]; then model_seg="$model ($effort)"; else model_seg="$model"; fi; rl=""; if [ -n "$rl5h" ]; then rl=$(printf '5h:%.0f%%' "$rl5h"); fi; if [ -n "$rl7d" ]; then rf=$(printf '7d:%.0f%%' "$rl7d"); if [ -n "$rl" ]; then rl="$rl $rf"; else rl="$rf"; fi; fi; out=""; if [ -n "$session" ]; then out="[$session] "; fi; out="${out}${model_seg} | ${dir}"; if [ -n "$used" ]; then out=$(printf '%s | Ctx:%.0f%%' "$out" "$used"); fi; if [ -n "$rl" ]; then out="$out | RL $rl"; fi; printf '%s' "$out"
